title: Rafael and the Asset
author: I. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Wren Oyelaran, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
